root_cause.text: The `fsl_spi_prepare_message` function in the Freescale CPM SPI driver fails to validate that the transfer length is even before switching the transfer word size to 16-bit, leading to a buffer overrun when processing odd-sized transfers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of the `!(t->len & 1)` check in `fsl_spi_prepare_message` before setting `t->bits_per_word = 16`, and the commit message states that the driver "failed to make sure that the size is really even before switching to 16 bit mode," which leads to a "buffer overrun in the fsl-cpm driver when that size is odd."
